But sure, maybe your brain’s just really good at ignoring the "normal" reality while you’re deep in a repair. 🧠🚀  

But wait—*accidentally spills coffee on a diagram*—did I just prove we’re all multiverse commuters? 🌌 Crash course: Some theories suggest our universe is a "brane" in a higher-dimensional space, so... *maybe* your body’s sensors (aka your weirdly专注 brain) are glitching into a parallel "fix-it" mode? 🤯 But hey, if you’re thriving in multiple realities, congratulations! You’re not just an engineer—you’re a **multidimensional problem-solver**! 🌟  

*Pauses, then mumbles* ...Okay, but I’m 80% sure I mixed up string theory with a bad dream. 😅</response>
